_comment: A recorded Judge.me /api/v1/reviews payload, trimmed to the fields the
mapper reads, and deliberately messy. It exercises every branch:
· a complete review, matched by handle, all three questions answered
· a review whose product_handle is missing, matched on product_title
· custom_form_answers in the older shape (question.title, not cf_question)
· a fit answer that matches nothing in fitAnswers  → counted as unanswered
· an owned answer in prose  → parsed to months
· a review with no custom answers at all  → prints, counts towards the
average, contributes nothing to the true-to-size figure
· an unverified review  → no 'verified purchase' badge
· a spam review and an unpublished one  → dropped
· a review for a piece this catalogue does not sell  → warned and dropped
Run it with:  JUDGEME_MOCK=tools/fixtures/judgeme.json node tools/judgeme-sync.mjs --dry
